name: herdr
description: Herdr workflow skill for a Jira ticket's workspace lifecycle. /ticket start SE-1234 opens a Herdr tab holding one orchestrator agent seeded with the ticket. /ticket drive SE-1234 is the orchestrator's playbook: description audit, Jira status, on-demand agents in their own worktrees, child tickets, and a stack of draft PRs. /ticket close [SE-1234] [PR#] closes out finished work: reconciles its docs, updates the Jira ticket, and tears down the worktree.
